title: Agent chat response
description: POST /api/v1/chat and /api/v1/chat/resume response. Every factual claim must reference the run it came from; status=interrupted means the graph is paused awaiting human approval (M6.6).

approval_required.description: Reserved (M6.7 Human Approval): true when the agent paused for human review.

approval_id.description: Reserved (M6.7): identifier of the pending approval request.

resume_token.description: Reserved (M6.7): token used to resume after approve/reject.
